facts.container_last_terminated: Container {container} last terminated with exit code {exitCode} ({reason}) at {finishedAt}.
facts.container_memory_limit: Container {container} has a memory limit of {limit}.
facts.deployment_replicas: Replicas: desired {desired}, updated {updated}, ready {ready}, available {available}, unavailable {unavailable}.
facts.no_problem_detected: No problem was detected among {pods} pod(s).

hypotheses.pending_insufficient_resources: The cluster does not have enough {resource} for this Pod.
hypotheses.pending_no_nodes: There are no nodes available to schedule the Pod.
hypotheses.pending_node_selector_mismatch: The Pod's nodeSelector or affinity matches no node.
hypotheses.pending_untolerated_taint: All suitable nodes have taints the Pod does not tolerate.
hypotheses.pending_unbound_pvc: A PersistentVolumeClaim of the Pod is not bound.
hypotheses.image_invalid_name: The image name of container {container} is invalid.
hypotheses.image_never_pull_policy: imagePullPolicy is Never but the image is not on the node (container {container}).
hypotheses.image_not_found: The image or tag {image} does not exist in the registry.
hypotheses.image_registry_auth: The registry rejected the credentials for {image}.
hypotheses.image_registry_unreachable: The node cannot reach the registry for {image}.
hypotheses.config_missing_reference: Container {container} references a {kind} that does not exist or lacks a key.
hypotheses.startup_volume_mount_failed: A volume of the Pod cannot be attached or mounted.
hypotheses.startup_wrong_architecture: The image of container {container} was built for another CPU architecture.
hypotheses.startup_command_not_found: The command of container {container} was not found in the image.
hypotheses.startup_permission_denied: The command of container {container} is not permitted to run.
hypotheses.startup_run_as_non_root: The security context of container {container} conflicts with the image user.
hypotheses.startup_runtime_error: The container runtime could not start container {container}.
hypotheses.crash_liveness_probe_failed: The liveness probe of container {container} fails and the kubelet restarts it.
hypotheses.crash_application_error: The application in container {container} exits with code {exitCode}.
hypotheses.crash_exited_normally: The process of container {container} exits normally (code 0) although it is expected to keep running.
hypotheses.crash_command_not_executable: The command of container {container} is not executable.
hypotheses.crash_command_not_found: The command of container {container} is not found.
hypotheses.crash_killed: Container {container} was killed with SIGKILL (code {exitCode}); the reason is not established.
hypotheses.crash_segfault: The process of container {container} crashed with a segmentation fault.
hypotheses.oom_limit_too_low: The memory limit {limit} of container {container} is lower than it needs.
hypotheses.oom_memory_growth: Container {container} may be leaking memory or has a load spike.
hypotheses.oom_node_memory_pressure: The node ({node}) is short of memory and evicts or kills containers.
hypotheses.rollout_controller_lag: The controller has not yet observed the latest change.
hypotheses.rollout_quota_exceeded: A resource quota of the namespace blocks the creation of pods.
hypotheses.rollout_pod_creation_denied: Admission control denies creating pods of the new ReplicaSet.
hypotheses.rollout_new_pods_unhealthy: Pods of the new ReplicaSet {replicaset} are unhealthy, so the rollout cannot progress.

recommendations.rec_reduce_requests_or_add_capacity: Lower the resource requests of the Pod or add capacity to the cluster.
recommendations.rec_add_nodes: Add nodes to the cluster or check the node pool.
recommendations.rec_fix_node_selector: Fix the nodeSelector/affinity or label a suitable node.
recommendations.rec_add_toleration: Add a toleration to the Pod or remove the taint from the node.
recommendations.rec_fix_volume_claim: Check the PersistentVolumeClaim and its storage class or provisioner.
recommendations.rec_fix_image_reference: Correct the image name or tag, or publish the missing image.
recommendations.rec_fix_image_pull_policy: Change imagePullPolicy or load the image onto the node.
recommendations.rec_fix_registry_credentials: Check the registry credentials referenced by imagePullSecrets (Kubron does not read Secrets).
recommendations.rec_check_registry_network: Check the network path and DNS from the node to the registry.
recommendations.rec_fix_config_reference: Create the referenced object or key, or fix the reference.
recommendations.rec_fix_container_command: Check the command, args and entrypoint of the container against the image.
recommendations.rec_fix_image_architecture: Use an image built for the architecture of the node.
recommendations.rec_fix_security_context: Align runAsUser/runAsNonRoot with the user defined in the image.
recommendations.rec_fix_application_error: Read the previous container log and fix the cause of the failure.
recommendations.rec_use_job_or_keep_process: Run one-shot work as a Job, or keep the main process running.
recommendations.rec_tune_liveness_probe: Relax the liveness probe (delay, timeout, threshold) or fix the endpoint it checks.
recommendations.rec_check_kill_reason: Find who sends the signal: probes, OOM, eviction or a manual action.
recommendations.rec_raise_memory_limit: Raise the memory limit of container {container} above {limit} after checking real usage.
recommendations.rec_set_memory_limit: Set a memory limit (and request) for container {container}.
recommendations.rec_investigate_memory_usage: Compare memory usage over time with the limit to tell a leak from a spike.
recommendations.rec_resume_rollout: Resume the rollout if the pause is not intended.
recommendations.rec_raise_quota_or_reduce_requests: Raise the namespace quota or reduce the requests of the workload.
recommendations.rec_fix_admission_denial: Fix the Pod template so that it passes the admission policy.
recommendations.rec_fix_new_pods: Fix the failing pods of ReplicaSet {replicaset} first (see their findings).

steps.step_check_events: Check the Events of the object for more detail.
steps.step_check_node_capacity: Compare the Pod requests with the allocatable resources of the nodes.
steps.step_check_node_taints: List the taints of the nodes and the tolerations of the Pod.
steps.step_check_pvc: Check the status and storage class of the claim.
steps.step_check_image_exists: Check that the image and tag exist in the registry.
steps.step_check_pull_secret_reference: Check that the imagePullSecret exists in the namespace and matches the registry.
steps.step_check_node_network: Check DNS and egress from the node to the registry.
steps.step_check_referenced_object: Check that the referenced {kind} exists (Kubron does not read Secrets).
steps.step_read_previous_logs: Read the log of the previous instance of container {container}.
steps.step_check_memory_metrics: Look at the memory usage of container {container} before the kill.
steps.step_check_quota: Check the ResourceQuota usage in the namespace.
steps.step_rollout_history: Compare the new and the previous ReplicaSet to see what changed.

missing.context_insufficient: Not enough context to name a cause.
missing.crash_no_termination_info: There is no termination record of container {container}.
missing.deployment_selector_missing: The Deployment has no readable selector.
missing.replicaset_selector_missing: The ReplicaSet has no readable selector.
missing.events_truncated: The list of Events was truncated; older events may be missing.
missing.logs_unavailable: The log of container {container} could not be read ({reason}).
missing.object_unreadable: An object could not be parsed and was skipped.
missing.pending_no_scheduling_info: The Pod has neither a scheduling condition nor scheduling events.
missing.pending_reason_unrecognized: The scheduling message is not recognised by the rules.
missing.rollout_no_pods: No pods of the new ReplicaSet were found.
missing.rule_failed: The rule {rule} failed and was skipped.
missing.source_unavailable: The source could not be read ({reason}).
missing.startup_reason_unrecognized: The startup message of container {container} is not recognised by the rules.
